title: Floor Generals: NBA Passing Network Analysis
description: Built a restartable ingestion pipeline over the NBA Stats API that collected 9,461 directed passer–receiver edges across all 30 teams. Tested whether passing-network centralization predicts team standing with a permutation test on Spearman correlation, and built an interactive tool that recomputes a team's passing graph with any player removed.

title: League of Legends Esports: Action and Win Prediction
description: Analyzed 150,348 rows of professional match data across 10 tier-one leagues. Predicted match outcome from 15-minute game state, where a tuned Random Forest reached 76.6% test accuracy. Used game-ID splits and GroupKFold to prevent leakage, and ran a fairness analysis comparing major and regional leagues.

title: US Interstate Wage Gaps, 2004–2024
description: Co-authored a research paper building state and county wage panels from BLS QCEW data, deflated to 2024 dollars. Found P90/P10 wage dispersion essentially flat at both scales despite wide county-level churn, and validated the result across four robustness specifications.

title: Taylor Swift Song Recommender and Lyric Search (DSC 10)
description: DSC 10 midterm project analyzing the audio features and lyrics of Taylor Swift's first eleven studio albums. Built a song recommender that matches a Spotify Billions Club track to her most similar songs by audio features, a lyric search tool, and a TF-IDF keyword extractor that finds the word that best summarizes each song on Lover.

title: Friends Reboot: Ratings, Dialogue, and Viewership (DSC 10)
description: DSC 10 final project using Friends episode, line, and emotion data to plan a reboot. Compared the top two directors' ratings with bootstrapped confidence intervals, tested for gender imbalance in the main cast's lines, ran permutation tests on viewership across seasons, built a random episode title generator, and fit a regression of IMDb ratings on viewership.

title: StoryAI: Student Writing Behavior Analysis
description: Coded 60+ hours of session video from 30 students into a structured behavioral dataset and built Tableau dashboards showing how student time split across planning, translating, and revising. The analysis supported a demo to around 100 educators.

title: StoryTrek: AI Writing Tutor
description: Co-developed an AI-based writing tutoring platform for elementary and middle school students on a 4-person team at UC Irvine. Designed and ran user testing with 10 students and teachers across a 3-month build cycle.
